content_sections.heading: NAM Assam Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the selection stages in detail or the contract tenure.

rows.details: National Ayush Mission, Assam (State Ayush Society, Assam)
Engagement on contractual basis in mission mode

content_sections.heading: About NAM Assam
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Director of Ayush cum Member Secretary (Executive Body), State Ayush Society, Assam, Dispur, Guwahati -06, for the National Ayush Mission, Assam. The posts are for the 50 bedded Ayurvedic Hospitals at Dudhnoi (Goalpara) and Sri Ram Chapori (Majuli District). The notice invites candidates willing to work in mission mode.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: There are 5 vacancies in total for the single post. The category-wise break-up (0 + 3 + 1 + 1 + SC not filled) adds up to 5. Vertical reservations applicable during recruitment are for Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribes (Plain), Scheduled Tribes (Hills), Other Backward Classes (OBC)/More Other Backward Classes (MOBC), and Tea tribes and Adivasi Community of Assam. Horizontal reservations are for Persons with Disabilities (PWD), Women and Ex-Serviceman. The notice says the number of vacancies may vary during the time of interview.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice mentions no experience requirement. Merely having the requisite qualification and experience does not make an applicant eligible for short listing. For further eligibility details, refer to the official notification. The age limit is up to 40 years as on 01/01/2025. The notice prints this date as it is. The category-wise maximum ages are given below. Age is calculated from the Matriculation/HSLC Admit Card or Pass Certificate issued by a recognized Board/Council. No other document is accepted in its place.

rows.qualification: BAMS degree from a recognized institute. Candidates must be registered with the Assam State Council of Indian Medicine. Preference will be given to candidates having a recognized Post Graduate degree in Ayurvedic System of medicines.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The remuneration is ₹50,000.00 per month. The engagement is on a contractual basis in mission mode under National Ayush Mission (NAM), Assam. The notice does not mention allowances. It says detailed terms and conditions and other criteria of the recruitment process will be published in due course on https://ayush.assam.gov.in .

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NAM Assam Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates have to apply online on the NAM, Assam website, printed in the notice as https://ayush.assam.gov.in/nhm.assam.gov.in . The online application form is available till 27.11.2026 up to 5.00 PM on the official websites of the National Ayush Mission, Assam and the National Health Mission, Assam. The selection process will be notified on https://ayush.assam.gov.in and https://nhm.assam.gov.in in due course, along with the list of provisionally shortlisted candidates. No separate individual call letter for an interview or selection test will be sent. The notice also says the authority may reject any or all applications without giving reasons.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Candidates must upload supporting documents against the post applied for, including: Educational qualification certificates from Matriculation to the highest qualification Experience certificate Caste certificate Registration certificate for Ayush doctors from Assam State Council/Board Computer certificate and other relevant documents, if applicable Matriculation/HSLC Admit Card or Pass Certificate for age (no other document accepted)

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: An incomplete application will be rejected without prior information. Claims for any correction will not be entertained after the online application is submitted. Selection details and detailed terms and conditions will appear on the official websites in due course. The number of vacancies may vary during the time of interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NAM Assam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 vacancies for the post of Resident Medical Officer (Ayurvedic) & Medical Officer (Ayurvedic). The notice says the number may vary during the time of interview.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The online application form is available till 27 November 2026, up to 5.00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: A BAMS degree from a recognized institute and registration with the Assam State Council of Indian Medicine. A recognized Post Graduate degree in Ayurvedic System of medicines is preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The limit is up to 40 years as on 01/01/2025 for Open Category (UR). It is 43 years for OBC/MOBC, 45 for SC/ST(P)/ST(H) and 50 for PWD.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The remuneration is ₹50,000.00 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no fee is required to be paid.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply online on the NAM, Assam website. The form is on the official websites of National Ayush Mission, Assam and National Health Mission, Assam, and supporting documents must be uploaded.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: The selection process will be notified on https://ayush.assam.gov.in and https://nhm.assam.gov.in in due course, along with the list of provisionally shortlisted candidates. No individual call letter will be sent.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The posts are for engagement on a contractual basis in mission mode under National Ayush Mission (NAM), Assam.

faq.question: Q10. Which document proves age?
faq.answer: Age is calculated from the Matriculation/HSLC Admit Card or Pass Certificate issued by a recognized Board/Council. No other document is accepted in its place.
